data.target: 1 = Charged Off or Default, 0 = Fully Paid (matured loans only)

evaluation: metrics on the test period; calibration = Platt (sigmoid) fit on the calibration period

feature_sets.without_pricing: all model features except Lending Club pricing: int_rate, installment, sub_grade

excluded.emp_title: free text with very high cardinality; would need NLP and risks proxying protected attributes
excluded.title: free text loan title, duplicates purpose
excluded.zip_code: geographic; fair-lending risk as a proxy for protected attributes
